preconditions.description: The input is a string of length not more than 100.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if any(name in stdin for name in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the problem name contains exactly one of Alex's friends' names, otherwise 'NO'.
